title: The Bouvet Island Lifeboat Mystery (1964)
hook: Who abandoned a lifeboat on the world's most remote island?
headline: Abandoned lifeboat on a ghost island

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: In May 1964 a Norwegian sealing ship vanished near Bouvet Island.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: A lifeboat washed ashore bearing a Norwegian flag and a dead crewman.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: The boat's logbook recorded entries up to 22 May before the crew vanished.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: No wreckage of the ship was ever found, leaving investigators baffled.

end.line: What do you think really happened on Bouvet Island?

description: Explore the 1964 mystery of an abandoned lifeboat on remote Bouvet Island.

facts.claim: The Norwegian sealing vessel M/S Tjeld disappeared in May 1964 near Bouvet Island.
A lifeboat with a Norwegian flag and a dead crew member was found on the island's shore.
The lifeboat contained a logbook with entries dated up to 22 May 1964.
No wreckage of the missing ship has ever been located.
Norwegian maritime investigators examined the evidence but could not determine the cause.
